001package pkg_commands;
002
003import pkg_engine.GameEngine;
004import pkg_entities.Room;
005import pkg_entities.Trainer;
006
007import java.util.HashMap;
008
009/**
010 * Starts a trainer battle, or lists available trainers when no trainer name is provided.
011 *
012 * @author Barnabe Jouanard
013 * @version 2026.05.08
014 */
015public class BattleCommand extends Command {
016    /** Indicates whether the battle command is currently in a player turn. */
017    private boolean aIsTurn;
018
019    /** Creates a battle command ready for the player's turn. */
020    public BattleCommand() {
021        this.aIsTurn = true;
022    } // BattleCommand()
023
024    /**
025     * Executes the battle command.
026     *
027     * @param pGameEngine the game engine containing the current room and battle manager
028     * @return always {@code false}; battles do not close the application directly
029     */
030    public boolean execute(final GameEngine pGameEngine) {
031        if (!this.hasSecondWord()) {
032            pGameEngine.getGui().println("\nUse: battle <trainer_name>");
033            return false;
034        }
035
036        String vTrainerName = this.getSecondWord();
037        Room vCurrentRoom = pGameEngine.getPlayer().getCurrentRoom();
038        HashMap<String, Trainer> vTrainers = vCurrentRoom.getAllTrainers();
039        Trainer vTrainer = vTrainers.get(vTrainerName);
040
041        if (vTrainer == null) {
042            pGameEngine.getGui().println("There is no trainer by that name here!");
043            return false;
044        }
045
046        if (vTrainer.isDefeated()) {
047            pGameEngine.getGui().println(vTrainerName + " has already been defeated!");
048            return false;
049        }
050
051        if (vTrainerName.equals("Rayquaza") && pGameEngine.getPlayer().getItem("delta-orb") == null) {
052            pGameEngine.getGui().println("You need the Delta Orb to battle Rayquaza! Find it and come back!");
053            return false;
054        }
055
056        pGameEngine.getBattleManager().startBattle(vTrainer);
057        return false;
058    } // execute()
059
060    /**
061     * Indicates whether the command is in a player turn.
062     *
063     * @return {@code true} when it is the player's turn
064     */
065    public boolean isTurn() {
066        return this.aIsTurn;
067    } // isTurn()
068}
